features: Paw Patrol-Themed Headphones: Have a little Paw Patrol fan at home? Make their day with these adorable headphones. It’s designed with a playful motif of their favorite character, Chase. This Paw Patrol-themed headphone instantly grabs little ones’ attention. It’s a delightful surprise that your little one will love using again and again.

Wireless Headphone with Mic: Let your child enjoy magical music moments anytime, anywhere with this wire-free Paw Patrol-themed headphones. It easily connects to mobile phones, laptops, computers, tablets, or any Bluetooth-enabled device. It’s powered by advanced Bluetooth 5.3, so pairing is quick and seamless within seconds. It also includes a 3.5 mm audio cable, so your child can simply plug in and keep listening even without Bluetooth. The headphone also features a built-in wireless mic, allowing kids to communicate clearly and comfortably. Whether it’s attending online classes, chatting with friends, or enjoying interactive learning, this headphone makes every moment easy and convenient.

Compact & Travel-Friendly Design: This headphone for little ones is thoughtfully designed to be compact and lightweight. Its foldable design makes it easy for kids to neatly fold and slip it into their bags, so they can carry it wherever they go. The convenient shape also allows it to be easily hung on a wall or hook when not in use. It’s practical, portable, and kid-friendly, perfect for everyday listening at home or on the move.

Comfortable & Kid-Friendly Design: Little ears deserve comfort just as much as style. This headphone is thoughtfully designed with soft, cushioned earmuffs that feel gentle and comfortable, allowing your child to enjoy music, stories, or learning for hours without discomfort. The adjustable headband easily adapts to different head sizes and provides a secure, comfortable fit for children of all ages, while keeping every listening moment enjoyable.

Safe & Gentle Audio: Little ears need gentle sounds. That’s why this mini Paw Patrol headphone comes with a built-in 90 dB volume limiter to help keep listening levels safe and comfortable for kids. It allows your child to enjoy music and stories, and helps them learn as well.

Unmatched Features: This feature-packed headphone for kids is thoughtfully designed to make every listening moment better. Its active noise cancellation helps reduce outside sounds, and allows children to enjoy music or attend online classes with fewer distractions. Its simple control buttons make it easy to use. Kids can turn the headphone on or off by long-pressing the power button, and adjust the volume by pressing and holding the 'volume +' or 'volume –' buttons. Let kids enjoy uninterrupted music with its convenient rechargeable design. The headphone features a Type-C charging port and comes with a Type-C USB cable, making charging quick and easy.
